email.subject1: a signal play for dbt Labs
email.body1:
Ciara, saw dbt Labs is reshaping the roadmap around the Fivetran merger and shipped dbt Copilot.

A merger plus a new AI product usually means more enterprise accounts in play in the Bay Area than the team can cover before reps ramp on the combined story, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for your territory off dbt's hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Ciara, quick follow-up for your Bay Area patch.

With the Fivetran combination, the enterprise pipeline target usually climbs faster than headcount can. Most teams don't know exactly how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your territory needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Ciara, last bit of proof for dbt Labs.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your territory's reply rate likely compares to other data-platform enterprise teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Ciara, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling territory pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority while the Fivetran integration settles, no problem at all. A merger is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an enterprise data-platform motion? I'll tailor it to your territory either way.
